content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online with crypto payments involves creating a streamlined architecture that bypasses the need for platforms like Stripe or Gumroad. This matters because it empowers creators to retain control over their sales and earnings. Conventional platforms charge high fees—Gumroad takes 10% on sales, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference can mean the retention of hundreds of dollars in earnings, promoting financial independence for digital creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling beats online revolves around a few key components: a reliable hosting service, automated delivery, and efficient payment processing. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automation, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you create a system that operates smoothly without reliance on traditional payment gateways. This setup ensures instant access to digital products for customers while guaranteeing that creators receive their payments with minimal fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators who operate in regions where traditional payment platforms are either unavailable or severely restricted. It empowers musicians, educators, and designers to sell their beats, courses, and templates without losing a significant portion of their revenue to fees. By providing a sovereign commerce stack, we enable creators to conduct business confidently and sustainably, ensuring that they can thrive in the digital economy.
Save money on fees—NOWPayments costs only 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this digital commerce architecture include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages, automated delivery systems such as Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Each element plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for the creator and the consumer. For instance, GitHub Pages offers free hosting, while NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility for both creators and customers. Together, these components create a robust framework that minimizes operational costs and maximizes revenue.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, set up your automated delivery system with Google Apps Script to handle product distribution. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to ensure you receive funds efficiently. Finally, load your digital products into your store and promote it to your audience. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which encompasses essential blueprints and templates to streamline your setup process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Own your infrastructure completely; no subscriptions, no dependencies.

If you're searching for ways to sell ebooks and digital downloads without conventional platforms, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all necessary blueprints and templates, enabling you to build a fully functional online store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
